source: kinematic Core with explicit mesh-floor projection
target_error_policy: Free move actions use a 1.0 m arrival tolerance requested by the user; posture and other actions retain the default 0.05 m tolerance. Persist the actually observed position, never the requested target. This policy change is not a new stability qualification.
notes: Version 5 separates arrival accuracy for free walking from stability gates. Only the free-walk target tolerance changes; all joint continuity, foot speed, floor correction, penetration and surface support limits remain unchanged from version 4. Combined root correction stays within 5 cm and 15 mm/frame; surface contact retains the symmetric 0.1 mm tolerance. No force or balance claim. This user-requested policy has not yet passed a new held-out qualification. Historical results keep their archived criteria. Qualification data stay outside agent context.
